title: The Second Book of the Rope Dart
summary: Carries the rope dart past its first lessons with spiral casts and a first use of qi in the point.

title: A Treatise on Looping and Snaring
summary: Teaches the many loops and snares of the cord and how qi can tighten them on a struggling limb.

title: Qi-Sent Dart Method
summary: Shows how qi sent along the cord guides a thrown dart and calls it home again.

title: The Whirling Guard Manual
summary: Builds a defense out of the spinning cord so the student can fend off blades and missiles at once.

title: Handbook of Rebound and Catch
summary: Trains the student to bounce the dart off posts and walls and to catch it again without pause.

title: Close Cord Work for the Dart Bearer
summary: Shortens the cord into the hand and shows how to fight at grappling range with dart and loop.

title: Cord and Dart Against the Long Weapon
summary: Teaches the cord and dart to tangle and defeat the spear and the staff on their own ground.

title: The Practiced Reach of the Tethered Weight
summary: Gathers the long-range throws of the weighted cord into one practiced course for the advancing student.
